_why: AGENTPROVIDER1 row a (the agent-provider design §9, O1-F18): the words a provider owns, which the census (`ProviderCensusTests`, and its twins in the service, the page and the tools) holds no site outside the providers' folders to name. The design reads this list from each provider's registered `Vocabulary` part (§2.3); until every provider registers, it is seeded here from the survey's lists (§1, §3, §6, §8, §10, §11), and row t deletes this file once every word comes from a registration. `words` rows: [the word, the provider that owns it, what it is]. A word is matched as written: a name made of letters, digits and underscores whole-word, anything that starts or ends in a dot, a slash or an underscore as a plain substring. The kinds: `variable` (an environment variable), `file` (a file or folder the provider's program reads), `wire` (a key on a provider's wire or in its records). Owners are provider ids (`claude-code`, `codex`, `dsh`).
